annotations.text:
B · Photo wall (chosen)
Polaroid prints taped to the lavender wall, staggered and slightly rotated, echoing the Art Wall cork board. Built into TeamSection.tsx: initials in a wash tint stand in when a member has no photo.

A · Storybook cards
Three columns so six people fill two even rows. Blob-masked photos, a class sticker chip on each card.
Tradeoff: designed around photos; with initials only, the blob looks emptier than a circle.

C · By classroom
One panel per class with the age tile, then the teacher; specialists and assistants in a wide row.
Tradeoff: needs a class field on each team member in Settings > Website > Team.

D · Name tags
Staff badges hanging from a dashed string, one row, each on a lanyard in its class colour.
Tradeoff: one row holds about six; beyond that it wraps or scrolls.
